BiblicalUsage: Palal the son of Uzai repaired the wall, over against the turning, and the tower which lieth out from the king's house. His father Uzai is named only as the man whose son took that stretch of wall.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wall-builders are named one by one because the work was done one stretch at a time: Palal's father Uzai is remembered only as the man whose son took his section, and that is enough.
